使用方法：

 第二步：选择个人合适的LORA

 第三步：点击生成。

 想要面部一致性，请更换一个面部LORA即可，并把这个LORA的强度拉到1

 不用换脸节点的原因是 换出来的效果没有面部LORA出来的效果自然真实。

LLL，In a lively urban setting, a vibrant 22-year-old woman stands confidently at the center of the frame. Her long, flowing hair cascades in loose waves, catching the sunlight that glimmers off its rich chestnut hue. She wears a stylish, form-fitting outfit that elegantly accentuates her silhouette—an eye-catching, deep red top paired with sleek black high-waisted pants, showcasing her fashion-forward sense. The backdrop features a bustling city street adorned with colorful storefronts and lively passersby, adding an energetic vibe to the scene. The late afternoon sun bathes the area in a warm, golden light, creating striking contrasts and playful shadows that dance across the pavement. The girl strikes a dynamic pose, her posture exuding confidence as she tilts her head slightly to one side, offering a playful smile that lights up her expressive features. Her eyes, sparkling with enthusiasm and a hint of mischief, draw in onlookers, while the soft sound of laughter and chatter from the crowd provides a lively soundtrack to the moment. This lively atmosphere is punctuated by the faint aroma of street food wafting through the air, hinting at the delicious flavors that await just around the corner.
